transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer logistics and hardware support. My name is Sean. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Sean. I am in the middle of a horrible, distressing nightmare with an S-Net courier delivery. Yesterday morning DPD delivered a parcel to my house containing a brand-new S-Net Hub 5 router, but when I opened the outer delivery carton, the dispatch invoice inside was addressed to my next-door neighbour at number forty-four, while my own faulty broadband router is completely dead!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that courier parcel mixup for you, Teresa. Can you provide your customer account reference number and the broadband Hub model?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My account reference is ACC-663810, the Hub model is Hub 5, and the DPD parcel consignment tracking number is DPD-9948201.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Teresa, that brings up the logistics dispatch records on my system. What is your telephone contact number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My phone number is 0113 496 0773. Sean, an hour ago my next-door neighbour found out that the courier left his parcel at my house. He came pounding on my front door like a lunatic, screaming filthy abuse at the top of his lungs, accusing me of stealing his mail and opening his private parcels! He kicked my front porch and threatened to smash my windows and call the police! I am a seventy-year-old pensioner recovering from heart bypass surgery and I was shaking so violently I had to take my emergency angina spray! Being terrorised on my own doorstep because S-Net's courier delivered the wrong box has left me terrified in my own home!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: DPD handheld delivery scanning systems record GPS geo-fence coordinates and electronic signature confirmation at ten-fourteen AM yesterday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sean, please, I don't care about GPS coordinates! I need this parcel collected and my own router delivered before that violent man comes back!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am opening the courier reconciliation interface to query the package barcode and carrier tracking history.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the courier consignment manifest show on your screen?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The courier manifest indicates two distinct S-Net Hub consignments were loaded onto the delivery van for your postcode sector yesterday morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the driver simply handed over the wrong parcel from the back of the van?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you read the twelve-digit barcode serial number printed on the white sticker on the side of the Hub box you received, Teresa?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The barcode serial number is SNET-HUB5-8839102-GB.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That barcode serial number matches neighbour account ACC-663811 at number forty-four.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where is my replacement router that was supposed to replace my dead Hub?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you receive a text message from DPD yesterday stating your parcel had been delivered or carded, Teresa?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I never received an SMS message or a calling card from the courier at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The second parcel was erroneously scanned as 'Returned to Depot - Incorrect Postcode Label'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So my router went straight back to the warehouse while I got my neighbour's box!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you cannot get along with your neighbours, you shouldn't be signing for their parcels in the first place, Teresa.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How dare you speak to me like that! I accepted a parcel addressed to my own door under the reasonable assumption it was my router! That was completely rude and offensive!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am booking a priority DPD courier doorstep collection to retrieve the misdelivered router from your house.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When will DPD come to collect this box so it is out of my home?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: DPD special courier collection is booked for tomorrow between nine o'clock and one o'clock under collection docket COL-448291.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have noted collection docket COL-448291.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was the DPD parcel consignment tracking number for the box delivered yesterday, Teresa?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sean, as I gave you right at the start, the tracking number is DPD-9948201! Why do you keep asking me to repeat tracking numbers that are already on your file?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, Teresa, I needed to cross-reference the docket in the collection portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please pay attention to what I tell you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The courier driver will bring a pre-printed returns label so you do not need to print anything.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is good because my home printer is out of ink.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct personal ownership of this logistics ticket, Teresa, monitor both consignments, and personally follow up until your connection is restored.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Sean, having a dedicated agent handling both parcels gives me some reassurance.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously scheduling an immediate courier swap is the required procedure to rectify delivery misrouting, Teresa.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Now what about my own replacement Hub 5 router?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have authorized an emergency next-day priority courier dispatch for a brand-new S-Net Hub 5 to your property.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When will my new Hub 5 arrive?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The replacement Hub 5 will be delivered tomorrow morning between eight AM and twelve noon with royal mail tracked express.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the tracking reference number for my replacement router dispatch?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The outbound express consignment number is RM-EXP-7729104.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have written down express tracking reference RM-EXP-7729104.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check your mobile notification settings to ensure you receive hourly courier tracking updates via SMS text message, Teresa.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile number is 07700 900641.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have enabled live SMS tracking delivery alerts to 07700 900641 with a thirty-minute driver arrival window.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The thirty-minute window is very helpful so I can be waiting at the window.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also credit your account with an emergency mobile data booster bundle to keep you online while the router is in transit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, my iPad can tether to my S-Net mobile if I have enough data.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have provisioned an unlimited fifty-gigabyte emergency mobile tethering booster to your SIM card free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The data booster is active on my phone already. That will allow me to check my emails tonight.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also apply a goodwill broadband billing credit for the three days of lost broadband connectivity.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I really appreciate that financial credit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have posted a fifteen-pound courtesy credit to your active account ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is fair compensation for the inconvenience.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The credit will automatically offset your next monthly Direct Debit bill, Teresa.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for putting that credit through.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the return packaging requirements for your dead Hub 5 router.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Should I place my old dead router into the box when the new one arrives?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the equipment being replaced under warranty dispatch RM-EXP-7729104 is the S-Net Hub 5.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the S-Net Hub 5 under RM-EXP-7729104. That is completely correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A prepaid Royal Mail return mailing bag will be included inside the replacement Hub parcel.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will drop the old unit at the local post office.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait Sean, what happens if the DPD driver shows up while I am at the chemist picking up my heart...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: He will leave a calling card. Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait Sean... he hung up on me while I was speaking! Honestly, what terrible customer service!
